Rae (Marketing): Brainstorm: benchmark post headline options that contrast 'serving-first' vs 'model-first' vendors. Need copy for blog, social, and a TL;DR battlecard for partners.
Chen (Product): Let's show 3 reproducible tests: cold-start p95, sustained 1k qps p95, and cost per 1M tokens. Use ModelB with 2048 seq.
Isha (Sales): Partner TL;DR should be 4 bullets: performance, cost, deployment parity, and rollout controls. Will make it partner-friendly.
Sofia (Growth): Social snippets: 1) "Serving matters: predictable latency, predictable cost." 2) "Model choice isn't the full story." Keep them short.
mkt-bot: Draft assets folder: https://drive.redwood/assets/bench-announce.
Rae (Marketing): Owners: Chen -> bench results; Isha -> partner TL;DR; Sofia -> social snippets. Drafts by Wed EOD.
Chen (Product): Will include quantization notes and a short methodology section.
Rae (Marketing): OK. Also propose a partner-facing 2-line script for demos: "We provide the same model APIs across hosted, dedicated, and private environments so customers can migrate without changing code."
Isha (Sales): Good. I'll prep a slide for partner enablement."
